  • Familiarity with infrastructure tools like Docker, Kubernetes, and IaC (e.g., Terraform, BiCep).

  • Working knowledge of DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines and monitoring tools.
  • Understanding of secure coding practices and basic enterprise security standards (e.g., IAM, encryption). Soft Skills:

title: Principal Engineer(Software Testing)
jobDescription:
Are you looking for a unique opportunity to be a part of something great Want to join a 17,000-member team that works on the technology that powers the world around us Looking for an atmosphere of trust, empowerment, respect, diversity, and communication How about an opportunity to own a piece of a multi-billion dollar global organization
We are looking for an energetic and self-motivated person with the Computer Science background to join our Firmware / Embedded Software team in the Communication Business Unit at Microchip. We are building firmware for high performance System on Chip (SoC) and Ethernet PHY devices developed by our hardware teams. These products include the PIC64-HPSC product, which is radiation-hardened multi-core RISC-V processor, intended for spaceflight computing and the Meta-DX2 product, an 800 GbE Ethernet PHY/retimer device for data center, enterprise, service provider, and AI/ML networking applications. These devices support the aerospace and communications markets as well as a growing number of applications in next generation embedded systems. Our focus is on technical excellence, teamwork, collaboration, and continuous improvements in an open and encouraging environment. If you have a strong technical background in firmware or embedded software testing, embedded systems, and communications protocols, then this is the position for you!
As a Principle Firmware Verification Engineer, you will be part of a team of professionals designing and implementing tests for embedded software and drivers for modern System-on-Chip (SoC) devices. You will participate in all stages of the firmware / embedded software project, for example: defining functional test plans, building/supporting test frameworks, automated regression environment and test infrastructure, designing and implementing tests and working with the Software Development teams to resolve bugs. This verification work spans the pre-silicon development phase, which uses FPGA-based prototyping platforms and the post-silicon phase which uses lab-based evaluation boards. Additionally, our team leverages AI tools such as Claude Code and GitHub CoPilot in all areas of software test development.
RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Technical lead for a small team delivering verification for major product features
  • Plan and prioritize team work (estimation, task breakdown, execution tracking) and remove blockers to meet milestone commitments
  • Coordinate verification activities with the India/Canada-based development team to align on scope, interfaces, schedules, dependencies, and delivery criteria
  • Mentor engineers on test design and debugging; review test code/designs and help improve team verification practices
  • Communicate status, risks, and mitigation plans clearly across sites through written updates and regular technical syncs
  • Translate functional specifications, requirements, and standards into comprehensive test plans
  • Architect and develop testing strategies for firmware / embedded software systems
  • Design, develop, and debug tests to verify firmware / embedded software and maintain these tests in regression
  • Developing and supporting our CI/CD automated regression environment
  • Developing and maintaining test frameworks for both pre and post silicon testing
  • Leverage AI tools such as Claude Code or GitHub CoPilot in all areas of software test development
  • Contribute to the analysis of 3rd party tools and the definition of processes related to test methodology and its interaction with development procedures
  • Setup and configuration of 3rd party test equipment and Microchip SoC test boards
  • Writing and reviewing comprehensive engineering documentation
  • Work with the product development, application, and validation engineering teams as part of test related activities
Requirements/Qualifications:
  • Bachelor s Degree in Computer Science or equivalent
  • Demonstrated experience as a technical lead for a small engineering team (3 to 6 engineers), including technical direction, work breakdown, and delivery ownership
  • Proven ability to work effectively with globally distributed teams and coordinate deliverables across time zones (including Canada/Pacific Time)
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills to drive alignment on requirements, priorities, and technical decisions across sites
  • 10+ years of related work experience in Software/Firmware Verification
  • Strong knowledge of C/C++ and Python programming and object-oriented design principles
  • Experience in using Claude Code or GitHub CoPilot
  • Experience with embedded ARM, RISC-V, or MIPS is an asset
  • Experience with Linux in an embedded system or an RTOS is an asset
  • Experience debugging tests and firmware with prototype FPGA/ASICs is an asset
  • Experience with Ethernet/IP/TCP-IP or other communications protocol development is an asset
  • Must be comfortable in a lab environment engaging in bring up and debug activities on hardware and firmware systems
  • Excellent analytical, problem solving, communication, and documentation skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills, experience as part of a collaborative development team, and a passion for mentoring those around you

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced and highly motivated Lead SoC Architect to lead the architecture definition and technical direction for next-generation semiconductor products. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in complex SoC architecture development, performance modeling, subsystem integration, and cross-functional collaboration across hardware, software, and system teams.

This role involves defining scalable and high-performance architectures for advanced compute platforms including AI, GPU, multimedia, networking, RISC-V or datacenter-class SoCs. This is a tech lead role. The ideal candidate must be willing to be an individual contributor while leading others.

  • Define top-level SoC architecture and subsystem partitioning for complex semiconductor products.
  • Drive architecture tradeoff analysis for performance, power, area, bandwidth, latency, and scalability.
  • Develop and review system architecture specifications, interface definitions, and microarchitecture requirements.
  • Collaborate with RTL, verification, physical design, firmware, software, and system teams throughout the development cycle.
  • Lead performance modeling, workload analysis, and bottleneck identification using C/C++/SystemC or similar modeling environments.

  • Contribute to long-term technology and product roadmap planning.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor s or Master s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in SoC architecture, ASIC development, or complex semiconductor system design.
  • Strong understanding of modern SoC architectures and subsystem integration.
  • Experience with one or more of the following:
  • CPU/GPU/NPU architectures
  • NoC/interconnect architectures
  • Cache coherency protocols (CHI/ACE/CXL)
  • High-speed interfaces (PCIe, UCIe, Ethernet)

  • Power/performance optimization

  • Experience with emulation, FPGA prototyping, and system-level validation.
  • Knowledge of Linux drivers, runtime software, or system software architecture.
  • Prior technical leadership experience across cross-functional engineering teams.

Technical Skills

  • C/C++/SystemC modeling
  • Performance analysis and simulation
  • RTL and microarchitecture understanding
  • AMBA/AXI/CHI protocols
  • PCIe/CXL/UCIe

jobDescription:
DAU invites applications from outstanding candidates for faculty positions in Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence at the Assistant Professor and Associate Professor levels.

While applications from all areas of Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence are welcome, the University is particularly interested in candidates with expertise in the following domains:

  • Computer Systems and Networking: Operating Systems; Computer Networks; Distributed Systems; Cloud Computing; High-Performance Computing.
  • Software Engineering and Data Management: Databases; Data Mining; Data Warehousing; Software Design and Architecture; System Analysis and Design; Code Analysis and Software Quality Assurance; Software Testing and Verification.
  • Human Computer Interaction and Interactive Technologies: Human Computer Interaction (HCI); User Experience (UX) and User Interface (UI) Design; Cognitive Computing; Interaction Design; Intelligent and Adaptive Interfaces; Game Design and Development.
  • Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning: Machine Learning; Deep Learning; Adversarial Machine Learning; Quantum Machine Learning; Multimodal Learning; Responsible and Trustworthy AI; Reinforcement Learning; Federated Learning; Artificial Intelligence and Ethics.
  • Natural Language Processing and Information Retrieval: Natural Language Processing (NLP); Large Language Models (LLMs); Knowledge Representation and Reasoning; Information Retrieval and Search Technologies.

Minimum Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must satisfy the following minimum requirements:

  • A Ph.D. degree in a relevant discipline, with a First Class or equivalent grade in the preceding degree(s), and an excellent academic record throughout; and
  • A strong and sustained research record, evidenced by publications in reputed peer-reviewed journals and leading international conferences.

Assistant Professor

Applicants should possess a Ph.D. degree, demonstrated research potential, and a strong commitment to excellence in teaching at both undergraduate and postgraduate levels. Candidates with postdoctoral research experience and evidence of independent research capability will be given preference.

Associate Professor

Applicants should have a minimum of six years of post-Ph.D. experience in teaching, research, or relevant professional practice, of which at least three years should be at the level of Assistant Professor (or an equivalent position) at a higher educational institution or research organization.

Candidates are expected to have an established record of scholarly achievement, demonstrated through:

  • High-quality publications in reputed journals and conferences;
  • Success in securing externally funded research grants and projects;
  • Experience in supervising doctoral students and mentoring research scholars; and
  • Evidence of academic leadership and professional contributions to the discipline.

Industry Professionals

The University also welcomes applications from candidates with significant industry experience and a strong research and innovation profile. Professionals who have made substantial contributions to research, product development, technology innovation, or industrial RD and are passionate about teaching and mentoring students are encouraged to apply.

The University particularly values candidates who can bridge academia and industry through collaborative research, technology transfer, entrepreneurship, and experiential learning initiatives.

Salary per year in Cost to the Institute (CTI) format

Assistant Professor: Minimum starting salary is 20 Lakh per annum.
(Exceptionally qualified and experienced candidates may be considered for higher compensation and additional incentives commensurate with their credentials, achievements, and potential contributions.)

Perquisites Benefits

Research Support and Professional Development

  • Seed Research Grant: Up to 10 Lakh to support the establishment of research activities and laboratory infrastructure.
  • Professional Development Allowance: A cumulative allowance of 3 Lakh every three years (on a reimbursable basis) to support participation in national and international conferences, workshops, and other professional development activities.
  • Research Excellence Incentive: Financial reward of 1 Lakh for each publication in top-tier A/A-ranked conferences and Q1 journals.

Health, Insurance and Other Benefits

  • Comprehensive Medical Insurance: Health insurance coverage of up to 10 Lakh per annum for the faculty member and eligible family members under a floater policy. The entire premium is borne by the Institute.
  • OPD medical reimbursement: 5000 per month for OPD medical expenses.
  • Children Education Allowances: 50000 per year ( 25000 per child, and coverage up to two children.)
  • Leave Travel Concession: 1.5 Lakh for a 4-year block.
  • Interest free loan up to 5 Lakh.
  • On-campus medical facilities, including visiting doctors and access to basic medicines through the University s Medical Centre.

Leave and Work-Life Balance

  • Casual Leave: 8 days per year.
  • Special Casual Leave: 15 days per year.
  • Vacation: Up to 60 days of vacation annually. Unavailed vacation is converted to earned leave (up to 30 days per year).
  • Earned Leave Encashment: Accumulated earned leave is encashable upon separation from the University, as per applicable policies.

Career Growth

  • Career Progression (Policy): A transparent and well-defined faculty career advancement framework that recognizes excellence in teaching, research, and institutional service.
  • Teaching Load: Faculty members typically teach three courses per academic year. To facilitate a smooth transition, newly appointed faculty members are assigned a reduced teaching load of two courses during their first year (one course per semester).

Research Collaboration and Industry Engagement

DAU actively encourages faculty members to pursue collaborative research and innovation initiatives with leading academic institutions, research laboratories, government agencies, and industry partners in India and abroad. The University provides a supportive environment for securing external research funding, undertaking interdisciplinary projects, and translating research outcomes into societal and industrial impact.

title: Lead Generation : Definition & Meaning
tagsAndSkills: conversion optimization,brand building,cold calling,back office,ai,business development,advertising,brand strategy
jobDescription:
Lead generation is the systematic process of identifying and attracting potential customers who demonstrate interest in a company's products or services.

What Is Lead Generation

Marketing teams, sales professionals, and business development specialists use lead generation to build sustainable revenue pipelines, reduce customer acquisition costs, and achieve predictable growth targets through systematic prospect identification and engagement processes.

What Are The Primary Lead Generation Methods Used By Marketing Teams

Marketing teams implement 8 primary lead generation methods to attract and capture qualified prospects. These lead generation approaches are listed below:

  • Content marketing: Organizations create valuable blog posts, whitepapers, ebooks, and educational resources to attract prospects searching for industry solutions and expertise
  • Search engine optimization: Marketing teams optimize website content and landing pages to rank higher in search results for keywords that potential customers use during research phases
  • Pay-per-click advertising: Companies run targeted ads on Google, LinkedIn, Facebook, and other platforms to capture leads actively searching for specific products or services
  • Email marketing campaigns: Organizations send targeted email sequences to newsletter subscribers, webinar attendees, and content downloaders to nurture relationships and generate sales opportunities
  • Webinars and events: Companies host virtual and in-person events, trade shows, conferences, and educational sessions to demonstrate expertise and collect contact information from attendees
  • Referral programs: Businesses incentivize existing customers, partners, and industry contacts to recommend qualified prospects through structured referral systems and reward programs
  • Cold outreach: Sales development representatives contact potential customers through phone calls, LinkedIn messages, and personalized emails based on targeted prospect lists and research

What Are the Types of Lead Generation

Lead generation encompasses 6 primary types that businesses use to attract and capture potential customers. These lead generation approaches are listed below based on their channel characteristics and targeting methods.

  • Content marketing, SEO, social media Attracting prospects through valuable content
  • Cold calling, email campaigns, direct mail Proactively reaching out to potential customers
  • PPC advertising, social ads, display campaigns Capturing leads through online advertising
  • Event-Based Lead Generation Trade shows, webinars, conferences Generating leads through direct engagement
  • Customer referrals, partner networks Leveraging existing relationships for new leads
  • Account-Based Lead Generation Targeted campaigns, personalized outreach Focusing on specific high-value accounts

What Are the Key Components of Lead Generation Systems

Effective lead generation systems contain 5 essential components that work together to identify, capture, and nurture potential customers throughout the sales funnel.

  • Lead Magnets Valuable content offers like whitepapers, ebooks, webinars, or free trials that attract prospects and encourage contact information sharing.
  • Landing Pages Dedicated web pages designed to convert visitors into leads through compelling copy, clear value propositions, and optimized conversion forms.
  • Lead Capture Forms Data collection mechanisms that gather prospect information including name, email, company, and qualifying questions to assess lead quality.
  • Lead Scoring Systems Automated frameworks that assign point values to leads based on demographics, behavior, and engagement level to prioritize sales follow-up.
  • Lead Nurturing Workflows Automated email sequences and content delivery systems that educate prospects and maintain engagement until they reach sales-ready status.

What Is Lead Generation Formula

Lead Conversion Rate Formula

Lead Conversion Rate = (Number of Converted Leads Total Number of Leads) 100

This formula measures how effectively leads progress through the sales funnel, with each variable representing critical performance indicators:

  • Number of Converted Leads represents prospects who completed the desired action, such as making a purchase, signing a contract, or scheduling a consultation within the measurement period.
  • Total Number of Leads includes all qualified prospects who entered the sales funnel during the same timeframe, regardless of their final conversion status.
  • Conversion Rate Percentage indicates the efficiency of the lead nurturing process, with industry benchmarks ranging from 2-5% for most B2B sectors and 1-3% for B2C markets.

Sample Lead Generation Calculation

A software company generates 500 leads through digital marketing campaigns and converts 25 leads into paying customers during Q1.

Step 1: Identify converted leads = 25 customers

Step 2: Identify total leads = 500 prospects

Step 3: Apply formula = (25 500) 100

Step 4: Calculate result = 0.05 100 = 5%

The 5% conversion rate indicates above-average performance for B2B software sales, suggesting effective lead qualification and nurturing processes that convert 1 in every 20 prospects.

Important Considerations

Lead quality varies significantly across acquisition channels, making total volume metrics misleading without segmentation by source, qualification criteria, and conversion timeframes. Track conversion rates separately for each marketing channel to identify the most cost-effective lead generation strategies.

What Are Lead Generation Related Terms

Lead generation intersects with 7 distinct business development concepts that professionals often confuse or misapply. These related terms represent different stages, approaches, and outcomes within customer acquisition strategies.

Key Distinction from Lead Generation Creates market awareness and interest before capturing leads Brand building and market education campaigns Evaluates and scores existing leads for sales readiness Sales process optimization and resource allocation Develops relationships with existing leads over time Marketing automation and customer journey management Complete process from initial contact to paying customer Strategic planning and performance measurement Researches and identifies potential customers before contact Outbound sales strategy and target market analysis Improves rates at which visitors become leads or customers Digital marketing and website performance improvement Tracks and manages entire customer journey from awareness to purchase Sales operations and revenue forecasting

Lead Generation vs. Demand Generation

Lead generation captures contact information from prospects who already show interest, while demand generation creates that initial interest through market education and brand awareness campaigns. Demand generation precedes lead generation in the customer acquisition timeline.

Lead Generation vs. Lead Qualification

Lead generation focuses on quantity by attracting and capturing prospect information, while lead qualification emphasizes quality by evaluating which leads possess genuine purchase intent and budget authority. Qualification follows generation in sales processes.

Lead Generation vs. Lead Nurturing

Lead generation obtains initial prospect contact information through single interactions, while lead nurturing develops ongoing relationships with those prospects through sequential communications over weeks or months until they reach purchase readiness.

Lead Generation vs. Customer Acquisition

Lead generation represents one component within customer acquisition by providing potential buyer contact information, while customer acquisition encompasses the complete journey from initial awareness through final purchase and onboarding activities.

Lead Generation vs. Prospect Development

Lead generation uses inbound methods to attract prospects who voluntarily provide contact information, while prospect development employs outbound research to identify and contact potential customers who have not yet expressed direct interest.

Lead Generation vs. Conversion Optimization

Lead generation creates systems and campaigns to attract potential customers, while conversion optimization analyzes and improves the performance of existing lead generation assets to increase response rates and contact capture efficiency.

Lead Generation vs. Sales Funnel Management

Lead generation feeds prospects into the top of sales funnels through specific acquisition activities, while sales funnel management oversees the entire pipeline from initial contact through closed deals, including lead generation as one input component.

What Are the Core Distinctions Between These Terms

5 fundamental differences separate lead generation from related customer acquisition concepts across timing, scope, and measurement criteria.

  • Timeline Position: Lead generation occurs at specific points in customer journeys, while demand generation happens earlier and customer acquisition spans the entire process from awareness to purchase.
  • Success Metrics: Lead generation measures contact capture.

At SIXT, AI is changing how work gets done and we are looking for the person who will help us do it safely. As an AI Security Engineer, you will shape how SIXT understands, assesses, and secures AI usage across the organisation, exploring where AI touches our data and systems, defining what safe usage looks like, and building the detections and controls that keep AI behaviour secure. About LoadShare

LoadShare is one of India’s most innovative and resilient logistics platforms, transforming how goods move across the country. Founded in 2017, we’ve grown to become a pan-India, multi-category last-mile network with a unique presence in both Tier 1 metros and deep Tier 2/3 towns.

What sets us apart:

  • Scale with depth: We handle ~550K deliveries/day across food, e-commerce (B2C), B2B retail, and digital commerce, powered by a 30,000+ rider network.
  • Strong financials, stronger ambition: With 800+ Cr in FY26 revenue and support from global investors (Tiger Global, Matrix, BII, Stellaris, BeeNext), we have a long runway and a path to profitability.
  • Dual-engine model: We not only operate India’s most flexible last-mile delivery network, but also license our in-house logistics tech platform that processes an additional 20 lakh orders/day — one of the few in India to enable asset cross-utilization across verticals.
  • Strong Tech: We are in a unique position to cross-utilize the delivery boys across different earning opportunities matching the peaks of various use-cases throughout the day. (ex: grocery peaks at 6-8 am, while bike taxi peaks from 8 to 10 am, etc). In addition to this, our supply chain SaaS platforms power over 1M+ shipments per day.
  • Strategic partner to India’s digital economy: We work with every major digital commerce player (ecomm, quick commerce, food, mobility) , and are expanding wallet share and capabilities within existing giants while co-creating new models with emerging platforms and brands.
  • Built to scale profitably: We’re not chasing GMV at all costs. We’re building the most capital-efficient, tech-enabled logistics engine in the country. We’re now building for our next phase: a 5X scale-up over the next 5 years, anchored in sharper client focus, deeper solutions, and new growth engines.

Founders/ Founding team:

  • Raghu Talluri (CEO) - Formerly at Myntra, McKinsey
  • Pramod Nair (CTO) - Formerly at Freecharge, Snapdeal, MartMobi
  • Rakib Ahmed (Co Founder, Head EComm/ Trucking/Warehousing)- Formerly at ICICI Prudential, Co founder Lunate Eco

The Role: Where Growth Meets Data Science

We're hiring a Data Scientist for the Rider Growth charter of LoadShare Product Org. This role goes beyond preparing data, conducting analysis and building dashboards. Your job starts where that ends: figuring out why a metric moved, and turning that into experiments and models that move it.

Your will look at the entire lifecycle of riders - acquisition, activation, retention, revenue and referral. You will own the why behind every growth metric and convert it into experiments and models that move the needle.

What You'll Work On

  • Causal analysis & RCA: Establish causation, not correlation, for why acquisition/activation/retention metrics move. Use controlled experiments, diff-in-diff, and quasi-experimental methods to move the team from "what happened" to "why, and what to do next."
  • Dynamic offers & incentives (ML): Build models for personalized/dynamic offers to address new rider hiring, engagement and reactivation at the right place and right time, balancing uplift in DAU and CAC.
  • Experimentation muscle: Design, run, and read rigorous A/B tests; own lift measurement; build the experimentation discipline so launches stop being "assume and ship."
  • Segmentation & cohorting: Rider and funnel segmentation, retention/cohort curves, and driver/decision-tree analysis to find the patterns that explain behaviour.
  • Forecasting & churn (retention side): Predict supply needs, churn risk, and recovery to inform retention and re-engagement strategy.

What We're Looking For

  • 3-5 years in Data Science/ML
  • Strong first principles — the core bar.
  • Python and practical ML: segmentation, decision trees, regression, and basic causal-inference methods.
  • Real grounding in experimentation and statistics — A/B testing, controlled experiments, reading lift honestly.
  • AI-native: uses Claude/LLM tooling to accelerate analysis
  • Strong communication, comfort being embedded with a PM and business teams, and a bias for action.

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Growth, activation, or retention analytics or ML modelling experience.
  • Experience with dynamic pricing/incentives, geospatial data, or experimentation platforms.

Department - Enterprise Architecture (EA)

Description:

We are seeking a director level Enterprise Architect to lead identity, API, and AI security governance across the global enterprise, operating at the intersection of cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure & platforms, and emerging AI technologies.

This role is chartered by establishing governance frameworks for MCP, APIs, Agents, and Skills, while partnering closely with platform, infrastructure, and data/AI teams to shape the future of secure, scalable AI adoption across Ford.

The ideal candidate combines deep hands-on technical credibility across cloud, AI, and security domains with the maturity of leadership to build and grow a large, cross-functional team of polyglot architects from the ground up, in a greenfield security architecture practice.


Responsibilities:

API Security Architecture

  • Design and govern secure architecture patterns for Ford's high-traffic, business-critical APIs, embedding security and governance directly into the API lifecycle.
  • Partner with platform engineering to strengthen authentication, authorization, and threat protection across the API gateway ecosystem.
  • Champion a shift-left approach to API security and compliance by embedding automated checks directly into the build phase, catching issues early in the development lifecycle. Familiarity with security tooling such as FOSSA, Cycode, 42Crunch, Cloud Armor, PRISMA is a strong plus.
  • Familiarity with open-source tools, applying buy vs build diligently and make decisions.
  • Building engineering prototypes which is kind of R&D (POC, Reference architecture), pre- implementation prototypes which are building blocks which perform in pre-production with minor tweaks.

Identity & Access Architecture

  • Architect a unified, vendor-agnostic identity fabric across Ford's global enterprise, resolving the complexity of a multi-IdP environment while eliminating vendor lock-in.
  • Define modern application authorization patterns — including OAuth On-Behalf-Of (OBO) flows and delegated access models — that scale securely across applications, APIs, and AI agents.
  • Establish governance standards spanning workforce, customer, and machine/non-human identities.

AI & Agent Security Governance

  • Define and enforce enterprise-wide governance frameworks for MCP, APIs, Agents, and Skills.
  • Partner with the Platform team (EPEO) to evaluate and govern the enterprise, AI Gateway.
  • Maintain deep, current knowledge of the agent-building ecosystem — low-code/no-code and pro-code options using Microsoft and Gemini Enterprise, plus hands-on expertise in the Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) — to guide secure, scalable agent adoption.
  • Collaborate with GDAI and data/AI teams to keep governance aligned with the pace of enterprise AI innovation.

Engineering Excellence – Patterns & Reference Architecture

  • Design and publish reusable patterns and reference architectures for AI solutions, giving teams across Ford consistent, secure building blocks rather than ad-hoc implementations.
  • Build starter apps/templates for the Google ADK, providing pro-code agent developers a secure, governed foundation to build from.
  • Define reference implementations mapping OAuth OBO flows with Microsoft Agent ID, ensuring agents securely act on behalf of users with proper identity context and audit trails.
  • Continuously evolve these patterns as Microsoft, Google, and other providers update their agent identity and authorization models.
  • Ensure starter kits and patterns are pre-approved, governance-compliant building blocks reducing time-to-production for new AI use cases.

Cloud & Infrastructure Architecture

  • Lead strategy for multi-cloud interoperability, ensuring consistent, portable security architecture across cloud providers.
  • Maintain a strong command of GCP architecture — scalability, resiliency, and cost/FinOps — to guide sound, cost-conscious infrastructure decisions. Partnering with FinOps EPEO team for the cost of architecture.
  • Partner with cybersecurity and EPEO infrastructure teams to ensure governance controls are technically enforceable across tooling and platforms.
  • Architect security solutions that directly protect and enable Ford's core business platforms — eCommerce, Ford Credit (global banking and financial services), and global retail/commercial fleet customer platforms.
  • Balance security rigor with speed-to-market for digital initiatives.

Applied AI & Insights

  • Apply predictive AI models to real enterprise use cases, delivering actionable insights that inform security, architecture, and business strategy.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with cybersecurity, platform (EPEO), infrastructure, and data/AI(GDAI) teams to align governance and reference architectures with evolving platform capabilities and enterprise roadmaps.
  • Serve as a key architectural liaison between security, engineering, and business stakeholders.

Team Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a cross-functional team of 20+ polyglot architects (Java, UI, AI, Python, GCP).
  • Build a culture of Engineering Excellence — driving technical rigor, continuous learning, and cross-skilling.
  • Set team goals and objectives, priorities, and development paths aligned with enterprise architecture measure success by defining OKRs and KPIs.

Strategic Technical Leadership

  • Serve as a Director-level technical authority on identity, API, and AI security governance, representing Enterprise Architecture in senior technical and business forums.
  • Proactively shape Ford's approach to secure, scalable AI adoption — anticipating emerging risks and technologies ahead of business impact.

jobDescription:
About the Role

VRTEKH (Vishnu Roopini Films) is a film production house building at the intersection of traditional storytelling and generative AI.

We are looking for someone who is exceptional at creating AI content generating high-quality AI images and videos and who will also edit those videos into finished, release-ready pieces. You'll be genuinely obsessed with using every AI platform available to produce films and online content, and skilled enough on a timeline to cut it all together professionally.

You'll create AI visuals and edit trailers, shorts, promos, social content and hybrid AI-generated films generating original AI content and stitching it together with live-action, VFX plates and audio into polished final videos.

What This Role Is Really About (Most Important)

  • Generate top-quality AI visuals: Produce sharp, cinematic, consistent AI images and videos film-grade, not generic outputs.
  • Edit the videos end-to-end: Take that AI-generated (and live-action) material and edit it into finished videos — assembling, cutting, pacing and finishing to a professional standard.
  • Master every AI platform: Be keen and fearless about using all possible AI tools — image, video, upscaling, relighting, lip-sync, voice — to create films and online content.
  • Prompt like a pro: Write, refine and iterate prompts to get usable, consistent, high-quality results and troubleshoot when a tool fights back.
  • Push creative limits: Constantly experiment to find what produces the best-looking, most original AI-generated content — and raise the bar every time.

What You'll Do

  • Create & edit end-to-end: Generate AI content, then edit and finish trailers, shorts, promos, reels and long-form pieces from raw, AI-generated and live-action material.
  • Edit for impact: Cut, sequence and pace footage; handle transitions, timing and story flow to keep every piece engaging start to finish.
  • Blend live-action with AI: Seamlessly integrate AI-generated shots, B-roll and VFX into traditional footage so the seams don't show.
  • Own the AI workflow: Generate, iterate on and refine shots across multiple AI platforms.
  • Craft sound & pace: Handle music, SFX, AI voiceover, dialogue sync, color and pacing to a professional finish.
  • Deliver to spec: Export clean masters and platform-specific cuts (16:9, 9:16, 1:1) on time and on brief.

What You Bring

  • Proven AI content creation — you've actually generated high-quality AI images and videos and shipped real work with them. (#1 must-have.)
  • Strong video editing skills — you can cut, sequence and finish videos to a professional standard, not just generate clips. (Equally essential.)
  • A genuine passion for AI tools — eager to master every platform and stay ahead of a stack that changes weekly.
  • Command of story, rhythm, timing and visual storytelling.
  • Fluency in a pro NLE — Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut Pro (After Effects a plus).
  • A self-starter mindset — curious, experimental, deadline-aware and comfortable with ambiguity.
  • Attention to detail — clean cuts, correct color, synced audio, and consistent characters and continuity across AI shots.
  • Your own laptop — this is an in-office role; candidates who can bring their own laptop will be preferred.

AI Platforms You'll Likely Work With

You should be at home in this world and eager to master more:

  • Video generation: Runway, Kling, Higgsfield, Google Veo / Seedance, Luma Dream Machine, Pika, Sora
  • Image generation: Midjourney, Nano Banana / Google Imagen, Flux, Stable Diffusion
  • Enhancement & finishing: Topaz Video AI, Magnific, upscaling / relighting / reframing tools
  • Audio & voice: ElevenLabs, Suno, and AI voiceover / lip-sync tools

Bonus Points

  • Motion graphics / VFX compositing (After Effects, Nuke, Fusion)
  • Experience on films, ads or branded content at a professional level
  • Color grading skills and a good creative eye for grade
  • A strong public portfolio experimenting with AI filmmaking

You will work hand-in-hand with Engineering, Design, Content, Data, and Marketing to ship a product that moves real numbers and real lives.

jobDescription:

We are seeking a Cloud Security Engineer with expertise in cloud security architecture, configuration, and governance across AWS, GCP, and Azure platforms. This role is focused on ensuring the security of cloud services and infrastructure, implementing best practices for secure deployments, and proactively identifying and mitigating security risks across multiple cloud environments. The ideal candidate will have primary experience with AWS, and strong familiarity with GCP and Azure.
Job responsibilities:
Engineering Responsibilities:
  • Design, deploy, and maintain security measures to safeguard our cloud infrastructures across AWS, GCP, and Azure.

  • Architect secure container environments, including Kubernetes clusters, Docker setups, and orchestration solutions, emphasizing vulnerability reduction and compliance.
  • Develop and enforce security policies, standards, and procedures for cloud environments and containerized workloads.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate security best practices into the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.
  • Work with the incident response team to investigate and remediate cloud security incidents, providing expertise on cloud-specific attack vectors and mitigation strategies.
  • Automate security operations and workflows using scripting languages like Python.
  • Develop and implement security automation solutions to continuously monitor cloud environments for compliance, threats, and performance anomalies.
  • Conduct regular security assessments, vulnerability scans, and threat modeling for cloud environments. Identify, evaluate, and mitigate risks in cloud infrastructure using automated and manual methods.
  • Partner closely with DevOps teams to fortify container orchestration platforms and containerized workloads.
  • Evaluate and recommend new tools, technologies, and methodologies to improve the security posture of the organization's cloud environments. Monitor and assess industry trends to ensure the cloud security program evolves with emerging threats and regulatory changes.
  • Collaborate with Project Execution Office (PEO) to create and maintain detailed project plans, timelines, and milestones.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation on cloud security processes, security controls, architecture diagrams, and risk assessments.
  • Report security risks, incidents, and findings to leadership and relevant stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to define project scope, deliverables, and expectations, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
Innovation and Creative Problem Solving:
  • Leverage creativity and technical expertise to design novel security solutions that address complex cloud security challenges. Think outside the box to solve unique security issues that arise as the company scales and adopts new cloud services.
  • Think beyond reactive security measures take a proactive approach to identifying potential vulnerabilities and threats. Use advanced tools, AI, machine learning, or custom-built scripts to anticipate future risks and mitigate them before they affect the infrastructure.
  • Investigate and implement innovative solutions such as AI-driven threat detection, security automation tools, and machine learning models to enhance security operations and reduce manual workloads.
  • Work with cross-functional teams, including security architects, engineers, and developers, to explore new ideas and develop innovative ways to automate, monitor, and improve security at scale across cloud platforms.
  • Stay at the forefront of cloud security trends and emerging technologies (e.g., zero-trust architecture, Quantum Cryptographs, Extended Detection & Response (XDR), User Behavior Analytics, Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), Cloud Workload Protection (CWP), Serverless Security, etc) and creatively incorporate these into security practices as appropriate.

About the Role: We are seeking a Staff Engineer - Cloud Infrastructure Security to act as a technical architect and leader across HighLevel s cloud platform.
This role is a senior individual contributor position responsible for designing and evolving secure, scalable, and resilient infrastructure on GCP, with deep ownership across Kubernetes, networking, IAM, and edge security (Cloudflare).
You will work closely with Platform Engineering, SRE, and Cyber Security teams to ensure infrastructure is secure by design, highly available, and aligned with modern best practices, while enabling teams to move fast safely.
Responsibilities:
  • Cloud Infrastructure Architecture (GCP):
    • Design and evolve GCP-based infrastructure architecture for scalability, resilience, and security.
    • Define standards for:
      • Project and environment structure
      • Multi-region deployments
      • High availability and failover strategies
    • Lead architectural reviews for high-impact infrastructure changes.
    • Ensure infrastructure supports high-scale, multi-tenant SaaS workloads.
  • Kubernetes Platform (GKE):
    • Architect and optimize Kubernetes (GKE) platforms for production workloads.
    • Define and enforce:
      • Cluster architecture and node pool strategies
      • Workload isolation and scheduling policies
      • Upgrade and lifecycle management strategies
    • Improve reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency of Kubernetes environments.
  • Networking Edge (Cloudflare):
    • Design and manage secure and scalable cloud networking:
      • VPCs, subnets, routing, and firewalls
      • Load balancing and traffic routing
    • Own integration with Cloudflare, including:
      • CDN configuration
      • WAF rules and DDoS protection
      • Edge security and traffic management
    • Ensure low-latency, resilient, and secure traffic flows.
  • Identity Access Management (IAM):
    • Design and enforce least-privilege IAM architecture across GCP and platform systems.
    • Define standards for:
      • Service accounts and roles
      • Access control policies
      • Just-in-time access and auditing
    • Partner with Cyber Security to continuously improve access posture and reduce risk.
  • Cloud Security Platform Hardening:
    • Build and enforce secure-by-default infrastructure patterns.
    • Partner closely with Cyber Security teams to:
      • Identify and remediate vulnerabilities
      • Implement security controls and guardrails
      • Support threat modeling and risk assessments
    • Secure Kubernetes workloads, networking layers, and cloud services.
  • Infrastructure as Code Automation:
    • Drive adoption and quality of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools like Terraform.
    • Build reusable infrastructure modules and automation frameworks.
    • Ensure infrastructure changes are Auditable, Repeatable Safe
    • Reduce manual operational work through automation.
  • Reliability, DR Operational Readiness:
    • Design and improve disaster recovery (DR) and failover strategies.
    • Define and validate RTO / RPO objectives.
    • Partner with SRE teams to improve Incident response, System resilience Operational readiness
    • Participate in postmortems and drive systemic improvements.
  • Performance Cost Optimization:
    • Identify infrastructure inefficiencies and performance bottlenecks.
    • Partner with FinOps and Cloud teams to:
      • Optimize resource utilization
      • Improve cost visibility and predictability
    • Balance performance, reliability, and cost in architectural decisions.
  • Technical Leadership Mentorship:
    • Act as a technical leader across Cloud Infrastructure and Security domains.
    • Mentor SDE2, SDE3, and Lead engineers.
    • Drive design reviews, architecture discussions, and best practices.
    • Influence teams across the organization without direct authority.
